context_identity.rule: stable, opaque application identifier; for a Project-backed Context use a deterministic namespaced form such as ctx:project:<project-id>; for non-Project Context allocate only after explicit user confirmation.

types.project: Backed by the Frozen Project semantic object; the only Fast Track implementation type.
types.program: A sustained Context assembled through existing objects/links; deferred from implementation.
types.goal_related: A bounded Context view; deferred from implementation.
types.life_event: A user-confirmed Context anchored by Event/Artifact evidence; deferred from implementation.
types.observed: A candidate or watching Context based on explicit evidence; deferred from implementation and never silently durable.

states.meaning: Proposed by user or system; no durable Context exists until user confirms.
User has confirmed identity/type/name/backing reference; an immediate transition may continue to active or watching.
Person is currently progressing or experiencing it; may supply a visible page context after authorization.
Still relevant but not an active commitment; it cannot manufacture a next Action.
No longer current; history/evidence remains governed by core-object lifecycle and authorization.

transitions.forbidden: old package or tombstoned evidence resurrection

project_compatibility.rule: Every Project can be represented as one Project-backed Context without changing Project identity or lifecycle. Context is a navigation/recovery composition; Project remains a Frozen core object.
project_compatibility.non_project_guard: Program, life event, observed, and goal-related types do not reuse Project identity and cannot become an all-life Project container.

counterexamples.expected: create a candidate only; no durable ContextId until user confirmation
do not read, include, or expand authorization

counterexamples.case: Closed Context has an old Action
counterexamples.expected: preserve Action/Feedback history; do not reopen Context automatically
keep Context identity but mark dependent understanding unavailable or review-required
